## Message

```
[X18N2003] Resource is not an object of messages <detail>
├▶ fix: Locale files hold nested objects of strings, numbers, booleans or null.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n2003
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A locale file parsed, but its top level is not an object of messages. A locale file holds nested objects whose leaves are strings, numbers, booleans or `null`.

1. Make sure that the top level of the file is an object, not an array or a string.
2. If the file is not a locale file, change `resources` so that its pattern does not match the file.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
